results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: H1 FY27 revenue is ₹4,404 Cr, already 54% of the ₹8,100 Cr FY27 target, so the target will be exceeded. Q3 FY26 was 28% of FY26; year-on-year growth slowed from +78% in Q1 to +61% in Q2, and we assume about +53% for Q3.
Operating margin has crept up from 6% to 8% over five quarters; we hold it at about 8%.
Revenue depends heavily on the gold price and on the festive and wedding season that falls in Q3.
risks: A sharp fall in the gold price lowers revenue and can squeeze margins
caveat: Skygold's last concall was Aug 2026; its Q2 FY27 call is not yet out, so guidance here predates the Q2 results.
